cells.rationale: The base rate from the last three first prints (197k, 199k, 194k) shows 2/3 above 194k, but the latest print sits exactly at the threshold. The consensus forecast of ~196k and the 'lowest since July' characterization suggest mean reversion upward from a local low, while the persistent low-fire trend and narrow recent range (194k-200k) argue for stability. Typical week-to-week volatility of 5-10k makes a move above 194k slightly more likely than not, but confidence is limited by the downward trend and low volatility environment.

note: Judge panel member forecasting from Claude's evidence brief before each cutoff; scored as a separate method.
